tour.title: Welcome — take the tour (optional)
tour.body: steakOS works best when you understand the big ideas first. The onboarding tour is a friendly walkthrough (processes, APQC, Bitcoin, Nostr, Bronze→Gold templates). Same origin as the app — no extra server.
tour.tip: If you pick a template in the tour, the wizard pre-selects it (localStorage handshake).

company.title: Your company
company.blurb: Who is this steakOS instance for? This becomes your legal entity in the company profile.
company.name: Company name *
company.primaryRailHelp: How you enter and book money. Bitcoin tips use a live rate (not stored on documents).
company.btcRailHelp: You enter amounts in sats or BTC. EUR/USD can appear as a tip from the live rate.
company.moneyHintNote: Conversion tips use a live Bitcoin price. They are not saved on invoices; settlement uses the rate at payment time.
company.dualSats: Show dual EUR + sats where available
company.taxRegimeHelp: Seeded from country. Operator owns rates — not legal advice (OI-F23).

site.title: Primary site
site.blurb: Start with one site. You can add more later in Settings.
site.name: Site name
site.sameAsCompany: Use the same address as the company
site.sameAsCompanyEmpty: Company address is empty — go back to the company step to fill it, or uncheck and enter a site address here.

banking.title: Banking
banking.blurb: Optional fiat bank placeholders. Choose SEPA (Europe) or ACH (US). Bitcoin receive is the next step.
banking.label: Bank name

bitcoin.title: Bitcoin receive
bitcoin.blurb: How this company receives Bitcoin in steakOS. Separate from primary value rail (books currency). steakOS does not custody keys.
bitcoin.level1Body: No live Bitcoin receive yet. Mock settle only. You can still book on a BTC primary rail. Basic literacy nudge.
bitcoin.level2Body: Occasional on-chain payments to one software-wallet address. Manual mark paid. Not Lightning / merchant-grade.
bitcoin.level3Body: Operator-run BTCPay (Lightning + on-chain). Enter connection fields here; probe and enable live under Finance → Payments.
bitcoin.level2Warn: Security notice: single-address receive is for occasional payments only. Never paste a seed or xprv. Plan to upgrade to BTCPay for regular Lightning / on-chain.
bitcoin.level3Hint: Secrets are stored encrypted. Enable live after Probe under Finance → Payments.
bitcoin.railVsReceive: Your books use Bitcoin as primary rail; receive stays deferred (mock settle) until you upgrade the integration level.
bitcoin.addressRequired: Level 2 requires a Bitcoin receive address (bc1… / 1… / 3…).
bitcoin.btcpayRequired: Level 3 requires BTCPay base URL, store ID, and API key.

nostr.title: Nostr
nostr.blurb: How steakOS uses Nostr for this company. Admin configures here. Never paste a secret key (nsec). Link a browser extension under Security anytime.
nostr.level0Body: Skip publish. NIP-07 login stays optional under Security. Local relay may still be installed idle.
nostr.level1Body: Publish selected audit events to the private local relay (LIVE only). DEMO stays mock-safe.
nostr.level2Body: Adds in-app Nostr notifications later (giftwrap). Partner DMs are out of wizard v1.
nostr.relayHint: Install seeds ws://127.0.0.1:7777. Editable later under System → Integrations.
nostr.extensionGuide: No extension yet? Install a NIP-07 browser extension (e.g. Alby), then link under Security after setup. Skip is fine (Level 0).
nostr.nsecRejected: Never paste a secret key (nsec). Public npub only, or leave blank.
nostr.npubInvalid: Operator public id must be npub1… or 64-char hex (or leave blank).
nostr.relayInvalid: Relay URL must start with ws:// or wss://.
nostr.relayDown: Not running yet. Choosing Level 1 or 2 will auto-install and start the project-local relay (loopback). Level 0 skips this.
nostr.relayEnsureWarn: Relay not reachable yet. You can continue and finish under System → Integrations, or go Back and retry.
nostr.relayEnsuring: Installing/starting local Nostr relay (may take a minute if building)…
nostr.relayReady: Local Nostr relay is reachable on loopback.

template.title: Choose your starting size
template.blurb: Bronze and Silver are open for selection. Gold stays on the ladder until that pack ships.
template.silverBlurb: Growing company — Advanced sales/finance, Governance, Stakeholder, optional email/Telegram (off by default).
template.ladderNote: Bronze and Silver are selectable now. Gold stays visible for orientation until productized.
template.notAvailable: Not productized yet — not open for metal selection
template.silverLockedHint: Not open yet. When productized: Sales/Finance Advanced, Governance + Stakeholder desks, optional email/Telegram (off by default).

families.title: What you will use
families.blurb: Families enabled for {{tier}}. Bronze includes the team desks (sales, money, supply chain, people, IT, and thin strategy).
families.blurbSilver: Fixed pack for {{tier}}: Bronze desks plus Governance and Stakeholder. Depth and messaging options below.
families.seedCoa: Seed a starter chart of accounts (recommended)
families.seedDemo: Load demo data (sample customers, vendor, catalogue items, task)

silverOptions.title: Silver pack options
silverOptions.previewNote: Preview only — you are rehearsing Silver options. Finish applies an open metal (Bronze or Silver) from the selection step.
silverOptions.depthBlurb: Sales and Finance run at Advanced depth on Silver (pack-mandatory). Not toggled back to Basics here.
silverOptions.messagingBlurb: Optional outbound messaging. Leave off until you add credentials under System → Integrations.
silverOptions.fixedPackNote: Governance and Stakeholder stay on for Silver — they are not individually switched off here.

privacy.title: People data & privacy
privacy.body: This pack includes people (HR) data. You (the operator) are the controller for personal data on this instance. steakOS does not hold your keys and does not replace your legal duties.
privacy.point1: Limit admin accounts; do not share the default admin password.
privacy.point2: Only store personal data you need for employment and operations.
privacy.point3: See the operator privacy guide in the docs for export, access, and backups.
privacy.ackLabel: I understand I am the controller for people data on this instance and will configure access and retention responsibly.
privacy.alreadyAcked: Privacy acknowledgement already recorded for this tenant.
privacy.required: Acknowledge privacy duties before enabling people (HR) data on this instance.

review.title: Review & finish
review.tip: Finish creates LegalEntity, Site, settings, optional COA, and marks setup complete. An admin can reset setup later from Settings.

celebration.title: You're ready for the grill party to begin
celebration.lead: Your steakOS kitchen is stocked. Company profile, sites, banking placeholders, and template are in place.
celebration.body: Next you will sign in. After your password, steakOS asks for a 6-digit code from your authenticator app — read the guidance below before continuing.
celebration.credsHint: We created user admin (password: admin) for you. Change this password after first login on any shared network.
celebration.credsHintAuth: Sign in with the Admin or CEO password from the Accounts step. After the password, steakOS will ask for a 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
celebration.authGuideTitle: Important: authenticator app required at login
celebration.authReadyAck: I have an authenticator app installed (or will install one now), and I saved my recovery codes offline.
celebration.authReadyRequired: Confirm the authenticator checklist above first.
celebration.ctaCopy: When your authenticator is ready, fire up the grill.
